generated_stance_accuracy.failure_pattern: Observed, zero-UQ, off-path and on-path free generation fell into observation-semantics or epistemic-limitation answer templates instead of emitting a planning stance.

task_risk_feature_diagnosis.inference: Observed and shuffled K summaries are highly aligned while their hard stance targets differ. The stance head consumes a normalized 4096-D bridge token rather than an explicit unnormalized magnitude side channel, so the current interface may attenuate exactly the scale distinction needed here. This is a source-supported inference, not a proven sole cause.

language_diagnosis.direct_evidence: Teacher-forced target answers beat their matched maintain/conservative alternatives, yet greedy generation selects answers from other QA families.
language_diagnosis.objective_gap: The matched preference loss contrasts only maintain versus conservative driving answers. It does not contrast the driving answer against observation-semantics, epistemic-limitation, or task-relevance templates for the same visual condition.
language_diagnosis.conclusion: Low target NLL and matched stance preference are insufficient evidence that free generation obeys the requested QA family.

label_audit.zero_uq: maintain remains a valid controlled counterfactual label
label_audit.off_path_uq: maintain remains a valid controlled counterfactual label
label_audit.on_path_uq: prepare_to_yield remains a valid controlled counterfactual label for this smoke
label_audit.view_shuffled_uq: caution is a constructed diagnostic label and must not be presented as uncertainty ground truth
label_audit.observed: A hard maintain label is not independently justified merely because the source frame is clean. Observed adapter U may be nonzero and task-relevant; future training should treat observed stance as unlabeled/calibration data unless an independent consequence label exists.

recommended_architecture_review: Train the matched counterfactual variants together in one optimizer batch so maintain, caution and prepare_to_yield gradients cannot overwrite one another sequentially.
Feed the stance predictor explicit raw K summaries, including an unnormalized magnitude path, while keeping the differentiable predicted stance token for VLM language conditioning.
Add question-family routing or a frozen structured answer prefix and contrast the target driving answer against all other QA-family answers, not only the opposite driving stance.
Remove hard stance CE from observed adapter outputs unless an independent task-consequence label is available; retain observed data for calibration, consistency and downstream held-out evaluation.
Evaluate the next design first as an offline objective/interface audit; do not submit another Route196 overfit run or the 8-event pilot under the failed protocol.
claim_boundary: Validated one-event architecture failure diagnosis. It does not negate the learned R/K ordering result, but it provides no held-out VLM-understanding, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
